DGROUP  GROUP  _DATA
_TEXT   SEGMENT BYTE PUBLIC 'CODE'
        ASSUME  CS:_TEXT, DS:DGROUP
        PUBLIC  _walk, _sum, _lenp, strx, _far1, _dosit
        EXTRN   _gv:WORD, _tbl:WORD, _cfun:NEAR, _other:NEAR, _bytev:BYTE
_walk   PROC    NEAR
        push    bp
        mov     bp, sp
        push    si
        push    di
        mov     bx, [bp+4]
        mov     ax, [bx+2]
        mov     si, [bx]
        mov     di, [bp+6]
        mov     cx, [bp+8]
        les     bx, [bp+10]
        lds     si, [bp+10]
        mov     ax, es
        mov     dx, ds
        or      ax, ax
        add     bx, cx
        sub     bx, di
        inc     bx
        dec     si
        cmp     bx, 0
        mov     ax, [_gv]
        mov     ax, _gv
        mov     ax, OFFSET _gv
        mov     ax, OFFSET DGROUP:_gv+2
        mov     [_gv], ax
        mov     [_gv], OFFSET _tbl
        mov     [_gv], 0
        mov     _gv, 5
        mov     al, byte ptr [bx]
        mov     [bx], al
        mov     byte ptr [bx+si], 3
        add     word ptr [bx], 2
        sub     word ptr [_gv], 1
        inc     word ptr [bx]
        dec     [bx+2]
        shl     word ptr [bx], 1
        shl     ax, cl
        mul     word ptr [bx]
        div     cx
        imul    bx
        neg     ax
        not     [bx]
        xchg    ax, bx
        xchg    ax, [bx]
        lea     ax, [bx+4]
        lea     di, [bp-4]
        lea     si, _tbl
        push    ax
        push    [bx]
        push    es
        pop     es
        push    OFFSET _tbl
        push    5
        pop     ax
        pushf
        popf
        xor     ax, ax
        xor     cx, cx
        and     ax, ax
        test    ax, 1
        cmp     [bx], 0
        cmp     [bx], ax
        mov     [bp-2], ax
        mov     ax, [bp-2]
        sub     sp, 4
        add     sp, 4
        mov     sp, bp
        mov     bp, sp
        mov     bx, sp
        mov     ax, [bx+4]
        mov     ax, [_tbl+bx]
        mov     ax, [_tbl+bx+4]
        mov     ax, _bytev
        cld
        rep     movsb
        repne   scasb
        lodsw
        stosb
        cmpsw
        xlat
        cbw
        cwd
        nop
        sti
        cli
        stc
        clc
        cmc
        std
        sahf
        lahf
        mov     ax, SEG _gv
        mov     ax, DGROUP
        mov     ax, _TEXT
        mov     es, ax
        mov     ax, es
        mov     bx, 100h
        mov     bx, 200h
        mov     ax, [bx]
        jcxz    done
        loop    done
        loope   done
        je      done
        jmp     SHORT done
        call    done
        call    _cfun
        call    _other
        call    _malloc
        call    __ffree
        call    [bx]
        call    WORD PTR cs:[tb2+bx]
        int     21h
        int     10h
done:   pop     di
        pop     si
        pop     bp
        ret
        ret     4
_walk   ENDP
_sum    PROC    NEAR
        push    bp
        mov     bp, sp
        mov     ax, [bp+4]
        add     ax, [bp+6]
        add     ax, [bp+8]
        mov     bx, ax
        mov     dx, [bx]
        pop     bp
        ret
_sum    ENDP
_lenp   PROC    NEAR
        mov     bx, sp
        mov     si, [bx+2]
        xor     ax, ax
lp:     cmp     byte ptr [si], 0
        je      lq
        inc     si
        inc     ax
        jmp     lp
lq:     ret
_lenp   ENDP
strx    PROC    FAR
        push    bp
        mov     bp, sp
        les     di, [bp+6]
        mov     ax, [bp+10]
        pop     bp
        ret     6
strx    ENDP
_far1   PROC    FAR
        mov     bp, sp
        mov     ax, [bp+4]
        ret
_far1   ENDP
_dosit  PROC    NEAR
        mov     ah, 9
        mov     dx, OFFSET msg
        int     21h
        mov     ax, 4c00h
        int     21h
        ret
_dosit  ENDP
tb2     DW      _dosit, OFFSET _lenp, 5
msg     DB      'hello$'
        DB      0CBh
        DB      0CAh
        DW      4
_TEXT   ENDS
_DATA   SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'DATA'
_val    DW      0
_arr    DW      10 DUP (0)
_ptrs   DW      _val
_cb     DB      1, 2, 3
_lbl    LABEL   WORD
        DW      OFFSET _val, OFFSET _arr
_DATA   ENDS
        END
@@@@
_TEXT   SEGMENT BYTE PUBLIC 'CODE'
        ASSUME  CS:_TEXT
        PUBLIC  _p2, _p3
_p2     PROC    NEAR
        mov     ax, 1
        db      74h
        db      0f0h
        db      8bh
        db      1eh
        dw      1234h
        call    _p3
        ret
_p2     ENDP
_p3     PROC    NEAR
        mov     ax, [bp+4]
        ret
_p3     ENDP
_TEXT   ENDS
        END
@@@@
_TEXT   SEGMENT BYTE PUBLIC 'CODE'
        ASSUME  CS:_TEXT
        PUBLIC  _bad
_bad    PROC    NEAR
        call    nowhere
        ret
_bad    ENDP
_TEXT   ENDS
        END
@@@@
_TEXT   SEGMENT BYTE PUBLIC 'CODE'
        PUBLIC  _q
_q      PROC    NEAR
        mov     bx, ax
        mov     ax, [bx+si+di]
        pop     [bx]
        ret
_q      ENDP
_TEXT   ENDS
        END
@@@@
_TEXT   SEGMENT BYTE PUBLIC 'CODE'
        PUBLIC  _q5
_q5     PROC    NEAR
        mov     ax, bogus
        frobnicate ax
        ret
_q5     ENDP
_TEXT   ENDS
        END

extern struct node *_tbl[4];
int _bytev;
char *_buf;
